Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting restrictions under the growth management act that regulate, impose conditions upon, or restrict the removal of potentially harmful trees and vegetation.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting restrictions under the growthmanagement act that regulate, impose conditions upon, or restrict theremoval of potentially harmful trees and vegetation; and adding a newsection to chapter 36.70A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Development regulations adopted under this chapter may notregulate, impose conditions upon, or otherwise restrict persons fromannually removing three or fewer trees and surrounding vegetation fromtheir property for the purpose of preventing potential harm to personsor structures on their property or on abutting properties.
